general.Don't victory-display the Spawn: one sta: Don't put Ungoliant's Spawn in the victory display. One of the two stage 3 cards is only won by defeating it, and there is a single copy in the deck.
general.Never take an undefended attack - shadow: Don't take undefended attacks. Several shadows here get worse when nobody defends: the Spawn raises threat by 8 instead of 4, the Hummerhorns deal 2 damage to every character instead of 1.
general.Tactics starter deck lacks willpower. Pa: Don't expect the Core Set's Tactics starter to win here. It has almost no willpower, so it only gets through if the deck deals it enemies to kill. Pair it with another sphere.
general.Under 32 threat dodges Ungoliant's Spawn: Under 32 threat Ungoliant's Spawn won't engage you; under 40 the Hummerhorns won't either. Going lower buys you little, as most of the other enemies engage cheaply anyway.

1.Forest Spider starts in staging, +1 atta: Have a defender ready early. Setup drops a Forest Spider into the staging area, it engages at 25, and its Forced effect makes it hit for 3 the round it reaches you.

2.Just 2 points. Build up first - stage 3: Only 2 quest points, so one ordinary quest phase clears it. Thin the staging area first, as beating this stage sends you to one of the two stage 3 cards at random.

3.Advance with the Spawn alive but nearly: If the Spawn turns up early, don't finish it off. Chip its 9 hit points down and advance with it alive: one stage 3 wins by defeating it, the other can't be beaten while it's in play.
